name: Safe{Wallet}
description: Safe, formerly Gnosis Safe, is a smart-account wallet that can require several owners to approve each transaction (multisig). Safe{Wallet} is its official interface, with built-in swaps, staking and third-party apps on many EVM networks.
description_zh: Safe（原 Gnosis Safe）是一种智能账户钱包，可以要求多位所有者共同批准每笔交易（多签）。Safe{Wallet} 是其官方界面，在众多 EVM 网络上内置兑换、质押和第三方应用。

geo_site.method: The Safe Client Gateway (safe-client.safe.global), which the app loads every Safe, balance and transaction from, is refused by CloudFront (HTTP 403) in some countries; the page itself loads and then shows 'Access Restricted'. The countries are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: BY, CU, RU).

geo_feature.scope: HEAD /swap -> 403 for OFAC countries -> swap/stake/earn/Safe token hidden; the core wallet works

tos.restricted: The Terms name no country: users must not be citizens, residents or members of any jurisdiction subject to EU or US economic sanctions (safe.global/terms, section 17, read 2026-10-12).

notes: Only native integrations are restricted (swap via CoW, stake via Kiln and so on). The core wallet is permissionless.
